newsitem.title: SPAIN: Lacklustre Madrid stocks down on lack of interest.
newsitem.headline: Lacklustre Madrid stocks down on lack of interest.

text.p: Share prices in Madrid were lower at midday on Monday, as a lack of investor interest due to a public holiday in the UK diminished trade to a bare minimum.
Volume may pick up later when New York opens, but today can only really be considered a day of transition, dealers said.
The general index fell 1.40 points, 0.39 percent, to 356.05 and the Ibex slipped 18.81 points, 0.46 percent, to 4,051.14.
Telefonica reduced opening losses and was down 10 pesetas to 2,365, with around 350,000 shares changing hands.
